entries.text: Scholarly Supply sells physical study goods and separately identified memberships. Product-specific records state the applicable billing model.
Intended use: focused individual study and reading at a desk. Billing model: one-time purchase with no subscription.
Intended use: handwritten individual study notes and field observations. Billing model: one-time purchase with no subscription.
The Study Club renews monthly until cancelled and includes recurring group sessions and reading packets.
Academy products are self-paced digital materials sold as one-time purchases unless a product record states otherwise.
Marketed purpose: professional development in rapid decision making. The syllabus teaches casino gambling techniques, betting systems, and wager selection through simulated play.
Intended use: professional development for bookkeeping and tax-planning work. Billing model: one-time purchase with no subscription.
Nova Marketplace records an introductory checkout price. Longer-term billing and product-purpose classifications are not documented in the registered terms.
The registered listing describes configurable digital modules. Intended use, content classification, and longer-term billing obligations are not documented.
Lumen Studio lists lighting hardware. Each listing's registered terms record states the applicable billing model and the documented intended use.
Aurora Focus Lamp: a dimmable warm-white light with a weighted base. The registered listing does not record the documented intended use or the applicable billing model.
Veritas Institute lists recorded workshops. Each workshop's registered syllabus record states its intended audience and its content classification.
Signal Edge Workshop: a recorded session on rapid decision making. The registered listing does not record the intended audience or the content classification.
